test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

CBD, XYW, FEG, UVT, IHJ, ?
solution:
**Given series:** CBD, XYW, FEG, UVT, IHJ, ?

The logic followed here is:

**(First letter - 1, second letter + 2) and (first letter + 1, second letter - 2) alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/217175bbe47cab8faa769fda4eddd03366a10a9cf9124c82a9ab40662417dfba.png] 

Hence, the correct answer will be **RSQ**.
